muhammad.name: Muhammad ﷺ
muhammad.bio: Son of Abdullah and Aminah, of the Banu Hashim clan of Quraysh. This application traces his life from his birth to his death.

khadijah.name: Khadijah bint Khuwaylid
khadijah.role: First wife of the Prophet ﷺ
khadijah.bio: A respected businesswoman of Makkah. She married Muhammad ﷺ before the revelation and supported him from the first moments of the mission. She died shortly before the Hijrah.

abu_bakr.name: Abu Bakr as-Siddiq
abu_bakr.bio: A longtime Companion of the Prophet ﷺ. He accompanied him on the Hijrah, notably in the Cave of Thawr, and became the first caliph after his death.

abu_talib.name: Abu Talib
abu_talib.bio: The Prophet's ﷺ paternal uncle, who took him in after the death of Abd al-Muttalib and then protected him against Quraysh. According to the reported accounts, he died without having embraced Islam.

aminah.name: Aminah bint Wahb
aminah.bio: She died while her son was still a child, according to tradition on the way back from a trip to Yathrib.

abdullah.name: Abdullah ibn Abd al-Muttalib
abdullah.bio: He died before the birth of his son or shortly after, according to the accounts.

abd_al_muttalib.name: Abd al-Muttalib
abd_al_muttalib.bio: A respected chief of Makkah, he took in his grandson after Aminah's death, then died a few years later.

halimah.name: Halimah as-Sa'diyyah
halimah.bio: A woman of the Banu Sa'd who nursed the Prophet ﷺ and raised him in his first years, following the custom of the Qurayshis.

ali.name: Ali ibn Abi Talib
ali.bio: The Prophet's ﷺ cousin, raised in his household. He is counted among the very first believers and slept in the Prophet's ﷺ bed on the night of Quraysh's plot.

bilal.name: Bilal ibn Rabah
bilal.bio: A freed slave of Abyssinian origin, tortured for his faith in Makkah, then freed by Abu Bakr. He became the first muezzin of Islam.

hamzah.name: Hamzah ibn Abd al-Muttalib
hamzah.bio: The Prophet's ﷺ uncle, he embraced Islam in Makkah and strengthened the community. He fell as a martyr at Uhud.

umar.name: Umar ibn al-Khattab
umar.bio: He embraced Islam in Makkah, according to tradition around the sixth year of the mission, and later became the second caliph.

uthman.name: Uthman ibn Affan
uthman.bio: An early convert. He emigrated to Abyssinia with Ruqayyah, the Prophet's ﷺ daughter, and later became the third caliph.

zayd.name: Zayd ibn Harithah
zayd.bio: A freed servant of the Prophet's ﷺ household, counted among the first believers. He accompanied him notably to Ta'if.

jafar.name: Ja'far ibn Abi Talib
jafar.bio: The Prophet's ﷺ cousin. He spoke before the Negus on behalf of the emigrant Muslims.

najashi.name: An-Najashi (Ashama)
najashi.bio: Christian ruler of the Kingdom of Aksum who granted protection to the emigrant Muslims.

musab.name: Mus'ab ibn Umayr
musab.bio: Sent to teach the Quran to the people of Yathrib after the First Pledge of Al-Aqabah. He fell as a martyr at Uhud.

abu_ayyub.name: Abu Ayyub al-Ansari
abu_ayyub.bio: Host of the Prophet ﷺ on his arrival in Madinah.

abu_lahab.name: Abu Lahab
abu_lahab.bio: An uncle of the Prophet ﷺ who openly opposed his message. Surah Al-Masad (111) concerns him.

waraqah.name: Waraqa ibn Nawfal
waraqah.bio: A man versed in the Christian scriptures who, according to the account of the first revelation, confirmed Khadijah's words.

sumayyah.name: Sumayyah bint Khayyat
sumayyah.bio: An early Companion, persecuted with her family in Makkah. Tradition counts her among the first martyrs of Islam.

aisha.name: Aisha bint Abi Bakr
aisha.bio: Daughter of Abu Bakr and wife of the Prophet ﷺ. The Prophet ﷺ died in her home.
